workflows.name: benchmark_quantification_pipelines
workflows.intent: Compare and benchmark multiple RNA-seq quantification pipelines on specificity and sensitivity metrics using a two-condition dataset.
input: simdata$quant (list of quantification matrices from compared pipelines)
simdata$samp (sample metadata containing condition and replicate information)
simdata$meta (feature metadata containing gene mappings, house-keeping status, chromosome, and true differential expression status)
workflows.stages:
1. Prepare condition and replicate factors, and logical vectors for evaluation and calibration features.
2. Calibrate quantification signals across pipelines using signalCalibrate to create an rnaseqcomp S4 object.
3. Evaluate and plot specificity on expressed features using plotSD.
4. Evaluate and plot specificity on non-expressed features using plotNE.
5. Evaluate and plot specificity for genes with only two annotated transcripts using plot2TX.
6. Evaluate and plot sensitivity in differential analysis via ROC curves using plotROC.
7. Filter out "on/off" transcripts to avoid infinite fold change bias, and plot sensitivity via estimated fold change distributions using plotFC.
workflows.code:
condInfo <- factor(simdata$samp$condition)
repInfo <- factor(simdata$samp$replicate)
evaluationFeature <- rep(TRUE, nrow(simdata$meta))
calibrationFeature <- simdata$meta$house & simdata$meta$chr == 'chr1'
unitReference <- 1
dat <- signalCalibrate(simdata$quant, condInfo, repInfo, evaluationFeature,
     calibrationFeature, unitReference, 
     calibrationFeature2 = calibrationFeature)
plotSD(dat,ylim=c(0,1.4))
plotNE(dat,xlim=c(0.5,1))
plot2TX(dat,genes=simdata$meta$gene,ylim=c(0,0.6))
plotROC(dat,simdata$meta$positive,simdata$meta$fcsign,ylim=c(0,0.8))
simdata$meta$fcsign[simdata$meta$fcstatus == "off.on"] <- NA
plotFC(dat,simdata$meta$positive,simdata$meta$fcsign,ylim=c(0,1.2))
